title: Real Bout Fatal Fury Special
note: Neo Geo fighting game: health, timer, 20 characters, super gauge (MAME cheat database).

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0xC0; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xE0 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0xC0; a K.O. can take it below zero, read 0xFF... and shown full before 1.31.1: from 0xE0 it reads empty (K.O. audit)

rounds.note: rounds won by player 1 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x6a82 P1 - Rounds Won [8 bits], the byte next to it in the 68000's order), gold stars under the bars and the winner of a round; to confirm in game (1.31.1, K.O. audit)

rounds_p2.note: rounds won by player 2 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x6a83 P2 - Rounds Won [8 bits], the byte next to it in the 68000's order), gold stars under the bars and the winner of a round; to confirm in game (1.31.1, K.O. audit)

score.note: player 1 score, BCD (RetroAchievements script of miagui/RAScripts on GitHub, its leaderboard), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2, to find with learn.bat (two-player game, score2=...)

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 1 Japan, 2 Korea, 3 Brazil, 4 Hong Kong, 5 China, 6 USA (Beach), 7 USA (Stage), 8 Germany (Day), 9 Germany (Night), 10 Geese Tower. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in %, full = 0x3C (MAME cheat database)

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in %, full = 0x3C (MAME cheat database)

_screen.note: the screen the game shows (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x41d0 Game - State [8 bits], 0x07 = Character select, 0x08 = Selecting a opponent, 0x0d = Fighting); its select screens give VS and no event of a fight (1.31.1, K.O. audit), to confirm in game

round.note: round of the match, from 1 in the game, read from 0 (RetroAchievements code notes, 0x6a36 Round - Count [8 bits]), shown as ROUND n when a fight begins; to confirm in game (1.31.1, K.O. audit)

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), see README, HD themes
